Cork A5 Notebook and Diary (Classic) – Eco-Friendly A5 Notepad

The Cork A5 Notebook and Diary (Classic) is designed for eco-conscious professionals, students, and organizations seeking a stylish yet sustainable writing solution. Made from premium eco-friendly materials, this A5 size cork notebook is an ideal blend of functionality, durability, and modern design. With 192 pages (80gsm), smooth ruled sheets, and a natural cork cover, this notebook is perfect for everyday writing, journaling, planning, and corporate gifting.

Crafted using sustainable cork, the diary offers a soft, earthy texture while maintaining long-lasting strength. The flexible yet sturdy cork exterior ensures excellent protection for your notes, while the elastic closure keeps your pages secure when you’re on the move. This eco-friendly notepad also features secure binding that allows flat opening for comfortable writing, making it ideal for work meetings, educational use, travel notes, and personal journaling.

As more users shift towards greener and sustainable stationery options, the demand for eco-friendly diaries and recyclable notebooks is rising. The Cork A5 Notebook meets this demand by combining environmentally responsible materials with a stylish, minimalist design. Whether you’re looking for a premium notebook for daily use or a thoughtful eco-conscious gift for employees and clients, this cork diary stands out as a functional and sustainable choice.

The 192-page (80gsm) ruled format offers an excellent writing experience with minimal ink bleed, making it suitable for pens, pencils, and markers. The compact A5 size provides ample space without being bulky, allowing you to effortlessly carry it in backpacks, handbags, or laptop sleeves. Ideal for creative professionals, writers, executives, and students, this notepad helps keep your ideas organized and accessible.
